newsitem.title: USA: Fed adds reserves via overnight system RPs Tuesday.
newsitem.headline: Fed adds reserves via overnight system RPs Tuesday.

text.p: The Federal Reserve added reserves to the banking system via a round of overnight system repurchase agreements on Tuesday, the Federal Reserve Bank of New York confirmed.

The current two-week maintenance period ends on Wednesday and federal funds have been under pressure. Economists said a permanent add to the banking system through the outright purchase of securities -- bills or coupons -- was possible as early as Wednesday.
Fed funds were trading at 5.63 percent, higher than the Fed's current official target level of 5-1/2 percent.
